proof_requests: Video of the machine powered on, motor running, and performing a straight stitch on fabric
Clear photo of any 'Made in' stamp or serial plate confirming country of origin
Photo of all included accessories (bobbins, needles, foot pedal) and the manual laid out together
Close-up of the plug, cord, and electrical switch
Photo/video showing the table legs and joints under light pressure to assess stability
response.reason: The witness confirms the item is an industrial sewing machine branded Emel, so it can be priced, but working condition, origin, accessories, and wiring safety are all unverified and must be priced at worst case until proven.
